capabilities.text: Use Microsoft Azure for cloud infrastructure
capabilities.quote: Yes, we’re using Microsoft Azure for our cloud infrastructure

capabilities.text: Run in the same region as the current electronic health record system (West Europe)
capabilities.quote: and the tool would run in the same region as our current electronic health record system—West Europe

capabilities.text: Connect to EpicCare
capabilities.quote: The tool needs to connect to two systems: our main electronic health record system, called EpicCare

capabilities.text: Connect to Sensus
capabilities.quote: and our ward management system, called Sensus.

capabilities.text: Note entered in the new tool appears in EpicCare within 30 seconds
capabilities.quote: it must appear in both systems—EpicCare within 30 seconds and Sensus within 60 seconds.

capabilities.text: Note entered in the new tool appears in Sensus within 60 seconds
capabilities.quote: it must appear in both systems—EpicCare within 30 seconds and Sensus within 60 seconds.

capabilities.text: Reduce nurse time spent copying notes by half
capabilities.quote: I’ve seen them spend an average of 7 minutes per shift just copying their notes from paper or one system into another, so this tool is meant to cut that time in half.

capabilities.text: Use a dedicated internal team of three developers and one business analyst
capabilities.quote: We’ll use a dedicated internal team of three developers and one business analyst from our digital health unit

capabilities.text: Supported by a nurse advisor from each of the three hospitals
capabilities.quote: supported by a nurse advisor from each of the three hospitals.

capabilities.text: Pull MRN and patient name automatically from a live list of patients on the ward
capabilities.quote: The tool will pull the MRN and patient name automatically from a live list of patients on the ward

capabilities.text: Live patient list syncs every two minutes from Sensus
capabilities.quote: which syncs every two minutes from Sensus.

capabilities.text: Nurse selects patient from a dropdown, no typing of MRN
capabilities.quote: The nurse only needs to select the patient from a dropdown—no typing the MRN.

capabilities.text: Observation time field auto-populates with current time
capabilities.quote: The time field will auto-populate with the current time when they start typing

capabilities.text: Allow editing of observation time
capabilities.quote: but they can edit it if the event happened earlier.

capabilities.text: Save note instantly, even if nurse hasn’t finished typing
capabilities.quote: the note must be saved instantly, even if the nurse hasn’t finished typing

capabilities.text: Show a green tick when note has successfully synced to both systems
capabilities.quote: Also, the tool should show a small green tick when the note has successfully synced to both systems

capabilities.text: Budget of £80,000 allocated for development and rollout
capabilities.quote: We’ve allocated £80,000 for the development and rollout of this tool, including testing, training, and support for the first three months.

capabilities.text: Show a red warning with a clear message if a system is down
capabilities.quote: the tool should show a red warning with a clear message: “Note saved locally but not sent to EpicCare—check again later.”

capabilities.text: Silent retry every 10 seconds for the first 2 minutes if a system is down
capabilities.quote: I’d also recommend a silent retry every 10 seconds for the first 2 minutes, then stop.

capabilities.text: Handle bursts of activity, like 10 nurses logging in at once
capabilities.quote: so we need to make sure it handles bursts of activity, like when 10 nurses log in at once after a handover.

capabilities.text: Test under load with at least 20 concurrent users
capabilities.quote: I’ve asked the team to test it under load with at least 20 concurrent users to be safe.

capabilities.text: Adhere to UK GDPR and NHS data protection standards
capabilities.quote: Default: UK GDPR and NHS data protection standards.

capabilities.text: Build EpicCare connection to existing Sensus-to-EpicCare interface specification
capabilities.quote: Our IT team already has a working interface specification for Sensus to EpicCare, and we’ve used it before for the fall-risk alerts.

capabilities.text: Nurse enters note once, saves and sends with one action
capabilities.quote: When the nurse finishes typing, she just clicks “Save and Send”—the tool does the rest.
